ideas.title: Investigating Federal Funding Issues
ideas.description: This story would investigate potential fraud and mismanagement related to federal funding, including the $12 billion funding freeze for the New York tunnel project.
questions: What is the extent of federal funding issues?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover significant fraud and mismanagement related to federal funding. By following the money and investigating the funding freeze, we may be able to expose a larger pattern of corruption.
